description: Call any iDoklad API v3 endpoint directly (find it with search_api_docs first). Path is relative, e.g. 'BankStatements'. List endpoints accept filter, sort, page and pagesize query parameters; filter syntax: (Field~op~value~and~Field~op~value) with ops eq, !eq, lt, lte, gt, gte, ct, !ct. Read-only mode: only GET is allowed.

body.description: JSON body for POST, PUT, PATCH.

name: idoklad_api_request
title: Call iDoklad API
